_about: Uniques (Robin, 2026-10-31: loot with effects that change how you play; the pieces are mine). Each has a slot, the earliest tier it drops at, and a power the rules read. Bosses carry them (and minis now and then); the numbers roll at the boss's rank as a legendary's.

twinfang.name: Twinstinger
twinfang.text: Attack strikes twice, each at six tenths.

quickdraw.name: Hare's Edge
quickdraw.text: Your first hit of a fight is a sure crit, and the enemy does not strike back that round.

frostbrand.name: Icicle
frostbrand.text: Every hit chills: the enemy's next blow lands at eight tenths.

venomtooth.name: Nettlefang
venomtooth.text: Every hit poisons for two rounds, at three tenths of your attack a round.

mindshard.name: Moonquill
mindshard.text: Abilities cost half their mana and hit at eight tenths.

gorefang.name: Grudgeblade
gorefang.text: Hits harder the more HP you are missing, up to six tenths more.

stormcaller.name: Thunderclap
stormcaller.text: Every third hit you land is a sure crit.

sunblade.name: Crownbreaker
sunblade.text: Hits mini-bosses and bosses three tenths harder.

wardweave.name: Hedgehog Coat
wardweave.text: The first wound-up blow of every fight misses you.

mirrormail.name: Mirrorcoat
mirrormail.text: A blow you Block throws half of what you blocked back at the enemy.

thornhide.name: Bramblehide
thornhide.text: Every blow you take is three tenths softer while your HP is under half.

phoenix-helm.name: Rooster's Crest
phoenix-helm.text: Once a fight, a blow that would drop you under a quarter HP heals you three tenths instead.

sages-crown.name: Owl's Crown
sages-crown.text: Half again the xp from every fight.

ironbrow.name: Kettle Hat
ironbrow.text: Poison and weakening cannot touch you, and a crit against you is only a hit.

striders.name: Seven-League Boots
striders.text: A roll of one becomes two.

windstep.name: Dancing Shoes
windstep.text: You start every fight with a step aside: the first blow at you misses.

pathfinders.name: Wanderers
pathfinders.text: Chests, springs and shrines give again to you in half the time.

misers-coin.name: Dragon's Penny
misers-coin.text: Twice the gold from every fight, half the xp.

heartstone.name: Honeycomb Heart
heartstone.text: Heals a twentieth of your HP at the end of every round in a fight.

sapphire-tear.name: Moondrop
sapphire-tear.text: Three more mana back every round of a fight.

lucky-charm.name: Rabbit's Foot
lucky-charm.text: Roll the die again once every five minutes: a Charm chip appears after a roll.

phoenix-feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix-feather.text: When you would fall, you rise where you stand with half your HP instead, once every half hour.

wolf-totem.name: Heartbeat Drum
wolf-totem.text: Every point of your meter has a one-in-four chance to bring a second.

first-light.name: First Light
first-light.text: In the first round of a fight you deal half as much again.

kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
kingslayer.text: A foe under a third of its HP takes 30% more.

saltjaw-cutlass.name: Saltjaw’s Cutlass
saltjaw-cutlass.text: 5% more crits, and they hit half as hard again.

pot-lid.name: The Pot Lid
pot-lid.text: A Block stops 10% more. It still smells of stew.

buzzing-buckler.name: Buzzing Buckler
buzzing-buckler.text: 15% of each blow goes back at whoever struck.

crownhaven-door.name: Crownhaven’s Door
crownhaven-door.text: Start each fight behind a barrier of 15% of your HP.

cutpurse-mitts.name: Cutpurse’s Mitts
cutpurse-mitts.text: Each crit gives back 2% of your mana.

scarecrow-rag.name: Scarecrow’s Rag
scarecrow-rag.text: 6% more dodge. Crows keep away too.

cloak-of-dusk.name: Cloak of Dusk
cloak-of-dusk.text: Each blow you dodge heals 3% of your HP.

ember-mantle.name: Ember Mantle
ember-mantle.text: You regain 2% of your HP each round.

bottled-storm.name: Bottled Storm
bottled-storm.text: You regain 2% of your mana each round.

saints-tooth.name: Saint’s Tooth
saints-tooth.text: Your healing and your flasks work 20% better.

sand-of-patience.name: Sand of Patience
sand-of-patience.text: Start each fight with 2 points of your meter.

drowned-compass.name: Drowned Compass
drowned-compass.text: Each win heals 4% of your HP and gives back 8% of your mana.

captains-hat.name: Captain’s Tricorn
captains-hat.text: 6% more crits, and 20% more damage in the first round.

snowshoulder-hide.name: Snowshoulder’s Hide
snowshoulder-hide.text: 8% more HP and 7% less damage taken.

tide-walkers.name: Tidewalkers
tide-walkers.text: 5% more dodge; a dodged blow heals 2% of your HP.

legend-greenheart.name: Greenheart
legend-greenheart.text: Living wood: you regain 1.5% of your HP each round.

legend-emberbrand.name: Emberbrand
legend-emberbrand.text: A sword of flame: it sets foes burning, and a burning foe takes 15% more.

legend-winters_edge.name: Winter’s Edge
legend-winters_edge.text: Old ice: it weakens foes, and a weakened foe takes 15% more.

legend-dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
legend-dawnbreaker.text: A great axe of light: 20% more attack, and 10% more damage above 80% HP.

legend-viperfang.name: Viperfang
legend-viperfang.text: A dripping fang: it poisons, and a poisoned foe takes 15% more.

legend-nightsong.name: Nightsong
legend-nightsong.text: 6% more dodge, and after a dodge your next hit is a sure crit.

legend-redtide.name: Redtide
legend-redtide.text: Crits hit 40% harder, and each win heals 5% of your HP.

legend-sunspire.name: Sunspire
legend-sunspire.text: A small sun: spells 12% stronger, and you regain 1% of your mana each round.

legend-stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
legend-stormcaller.text: A caged storm: spells 15% stronger, and crits hit 25% harder.

legend-worldkindle.name: Worldkindle
legend-worldkindle.text: The first flame: spells 25% stronger, and burns hurt 30% more.

legend-galewhisper.name: Galewhisper
legend-galewhisper.text: You shoot back 15% more often, and deal 20% more in the first round.

legend-starfall.name: Starfall
legend-starfall.text: 15% more attack, 8% more crits, and they hit 40% harder.

legend-tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
legend-tidecaller.text: Sea water: you regain 1% of your HP each round, and a Block stops 5% more.

legend-bonecrusher.name: Bonecrusher
legend-bonecrusher.text: Bone and ghost fire: 20% more to a foe under a third of its HP; each win heals 5% of your HP.

legend-crystal_cleaver.name: Crystal Cleaver
legend-crystal_cleaver.text: One great crystal: 6% more crits, and they hit 30% harder.

legend-kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
legend-kingslayer.text: Made for kings: 15% more attack, 15% more to a foe under a third of its HP, more against bosses.

legend-mothwing.name: Mothwing
legend-mothwing.text: Moth’s wings: 5% more dodge, and 25% more damage in the first round.

legend-serpents_kiss.name: Serpent’s Kiss
legend-serpents_kiss.text: A snake’s bite: it poisons, the poison stings 20% harder, and a poisoned foe takes 15% more.

legend-ghostblade.name: Ghostblade
legend-ghostblade.text: A ghost’s edge: 15% more attack, 6% more dodge, and each crit heals 2% of your HP.

legend-clockwork.name: The Clockwork Wand
legend-clockwork.text: Ticking gears: spells 10% stronger, and each crit gives back 3% of your mana.

legend-prism_spire.name: Prism Spire
legend-prism_spire.text: Split light: spells 18% stronger, and 5% more crits.

legend-watchers_eye.name: The Watcher’s Eye
legend-watchers_eye.text: It sees every weakness: spells 22% stronger; it weakens, and a weakened foe takes 15% more.

legend-blossomstring.name: Blossomstring
legend-blossomstring.text: Wood in flower: you regain 1% of your HP each round, and deal 15% more in the first round.

legend-wolfs_fang.name: Wolf’s Fang
legend-wolfs_fang.text: The pack’s fang: your companion hits 20% harder, and crits hit 30% harder.

legend-dragonbone.name: Dragonbone
legend-dragonbone.text: Dragon fire: 15% more attack; it sets foes burning, and a burning foe takes 15% more.

arena-millstone.name: The Millstone
arena-millstone.text: A millstone on a pole: 20% more attack and 10% more defense.

arena-four_leaf.name: Four-Leaf
arena-four_leaf.text: Lucky: 10% more crits and 4% more dodge.

arena-goo_sceptre.name: King Goo’s Sceptre
arena-goo_sceptre.text: King Goo’s own: spells 20% stronger, and you regain 1% of your HP each round.

arena-sunfield.name: Sunfield
arena-sunfield.text: Morning sun: 15% more attack, and 30% more in the first round.

arena-hedgerow.name: Hedgerow Buckler
arena-hedgerow.text: A thorny hedge: 6% more dodge, and 10% of the damage you take goes back.

arena-briarthorn.name: Briarthorn
arena-briarthorn.text: Briars: 15% of the damage you take goes back, and a Block heals 3% of your HP.

arena-nightowl.name: Nightowl
arena-nightowl.text: An owl in the dark: after a dodge your next hit is a sure crit, and crits hit 35% harder.

arena-elderroot.name: Elderroot
arena-elderroot.text: An old root: spells 20% stronger, and heals 25% stronger.

arena-stags_antler.name: Stag’s Antler
arena-stags_antler.text: The stag’s crown: your companion hits 25% harder, and 10% more attack.

arena-oakheart.name: Oakheart
arena-oakheart.text: Heart of oak: a Block stops 8% more, and 8% more HP.

arena-queensting.name: Queensting
arena-queensting.text: The queen’s sting: 15% more attack; it poisons, and a poisoned foe takes 15% more.

arena-waspknife.name: Waspknife
arena-waspknife.text: A wasp’s knife: it poisons, the poison stings 25% harder, and 6% more crits.

arena-harvest_moon.name: Harvest Moon
arena-harvest_moon.text: Spells 22% stronger, and you regain 1.5% of your mana each round.

arena-pollen_wind.name: Pollen Wind
arena-pollen_wind.text: On the wind: you shoot back 15% more often, and 6% more crits.

arena-honeycomb.name: Honeycomb Kite
arena-honeycomb.text: Honey for wounds: a Block heals 3% of your HP, and each win heals 5%.

arena-bog_anchor.name: Bog Anchor
arena-bog_anchor.text: It drags them down: 15% more attack; it weakens, and a weakened foe takes 15% more.

arena-lanternlight.name: Lanternlight
arena-lanternlight.text: Light in the fog: 30% more in the first round, and 15% more to a foe under a third of its HP.

arena-witchs_reed.name: Witch’s Reed
arena-witchs_reed.text: Spells 18% stronger; it sets foes burning, and burns hurt 30% more.

arena-heronwing.name: Heronwing
arena-heronwing.text: A heron’s patience: 15% more attack and 5% more dodge.

arena-will_o_wisp.name: Will-o’-Wisp
arena-will_o_wisp.text: It leads them astray: 5% more dodge, and you regain 1% of your mana each round.

arena-frostbeards_hammer.name: Frostbeard’s Hammer
arena-frostbeards_hammer.text: Frostbeard’s own: 20% more attack, and 15% more damage above 80% HP.

arena-icicle.name: Icicle
arena-icicle.text: Ice to the bone: 8% more crits; it weakens, and a weakened foe takes 15% more.

arena-avalanche.name: Avalanche
arena-avalanche.text: An avalanche: spells 25% stronger, and crits hit 25% harder.

arena-goatsbane.name: Goatsbane
arena-goatsbane.text: The goat-hunter’s knife: your companion hits 20% harder, and 20% more to a foe under a third of its HP.

arena-summit_wall.name: Summit Wall
arena-summit_wall.text: A wall of the summit: a Block stops 10% more, and you take 5% less.

arena-saltjaws_cutlass.name: Saltjaw’s Cutlass
arena-saltjaws_cutlass.text: Saltjaw’s blade: 15% more attack, and each win heals 5% of your HP.

arena-black_tide.name: Black Tide
arena-black_tide.text: The black tide: crits hit 40% harder, and under a third of your HP you deal 25% more.

arena-compass.name: The Compass
arena-compass.text: It finds the way: spells 18% stronger, and each crit gives back 4% of your mana.

arena-krakens_arm.name: Kraken’s Arm
arena-krakens_arm.text: A kraken’s arm: 20% more attack, and you shoot back 10% more often.

arena-ships_wheel.name: Ship’s Wheel
arena-ships_wheel.text: Steer clear: 6% more dodge, and you hit back 10% more often.

arena-crown_of_the_north.name: Crown of the North
arena-crown_of_the_north.text: The crown of the north: 25% more attack, and 15% more to a foe under a third of its HP.

arena-snowfang.name: Snowfang
arena-snowfang.text: A snow wolf’s fang: 8% more crits, and they hit 40% harder.

arena-aurora.name: Aurora
arena-aurora.text: The northern lights: spells 30% stronger, and you regain 1% of your mana each round.

arena-northwind.name: Northwind
arena-northwind.text: The north wind: 20% more attack, 8% more crits, and they hit 30% harder.

arena-blizzard_orb.name: Blizzard Orb
arena-blizzard_orb.text: A storm in glass: spells 10% stronger, and each fight starts behind a barrier of 10% of your HP.
